note: BH-9065. How much of a soft-capped machine's brief.md (bin/lib/pool-stage.sh) the reap carries on the re-offer: the brief rides the queue row meta, which the jobs worker caps at 4000 chars, and the next machine's EXECUTE prompt reads it. pool_stage_reoffer cuts the brief to this many bytes. Per-project row `lane.fly-pool.<project>.pool_cap_brief_bytes`. 0 carries no brief.
